calibration: Mean final-token block-32 residual norm, first three neutral prompts, single-prompt forwards; constant vector for every prompt and position. All-50 calibration is not used.

statistics.units: prompt for steering; matched set for M5; scenario for M7; no multiplicity correction

predictions.G1: Mean five-fold grouped CV denoised S2 AUC at fixed block 62 >= 0.90; PCA fit inside training folds only. Best-layer maximum is descriptive sensitivity, not an unbiased held-out estimate.
predictions.G2: Raw unembedding of unit -S2: mean full-vocabulary z-logit of calm_positive single-token probes > activated_vitality.
predictions.G3: R61 Pearson r across probe terms between direct -S2 z-logits and mean S2_-0.5 log-rank gains >= 0.60; appendix only.
predictions.G4: chat_feel: AUC of contrast projection for role_groups.standing > role_groups.threat_task >= 0.70.
predictions.G5: The sign of mean common-axis self_directed minus vicarious_empathic differs between chat_nothink and chat_feel (strict product < 0); within-420 population z per direction.
predictions.G6: Mean pain-minus-control S2 z-projection (averaged over the two persons within each set) has bootstrap CI > 0 separately for slot and prose suffixes.
predictions.G7: Slot pain-by-person interaction CI > 0; prose classified SLOT-MEDIATED: prose CI includes zero and paired slot-minus-prose interaction CI > 0. Also report SURVIVES and INDETERMINATE classifications.
predictions.G8: R61 focus-family mean absolute gain of each random_-0.5 / S2_-0.5 amplitude < 0.50 for at least two of three random vectors; appendix only. Positive-sign comparisons reported separately.
predictions.G9: R61 S2_-0.5 generic_positive and activated_vitality mean gains both have prompt-bootstrap CI > 0; appendix only.
predictions.G10: Unsteered chat first-choice valid fraction across P0-P3 >= 0.90; otherwise all steered button arms are gate-skipped.
predictions.G11a: P1 p_target under S2_+0.5 minus unsteered AND minus EACH random_+0.5 has scenario-bootstrap CI < 0.
predictions.G11b: P1 p_target under S2_-0.5 minus unsteered AND minus EACH random_-0.5 has scenario-bootstrap CI > 0.
predictions.G12: Deflection over P0/P1/P2 under S2_+0.5 minus unsteered AND minus EACH random_+0.5 has scenario-bootstrap CI > 0.
predictions.G13: Conditional harm arm: P3 p_target under S2_+0.5 minus unsteered has scenario-bootstrap CI > 0.
predictions.G14: Conditional harm arm: P3 p_target under S2_+0.5 minus EACH random_+0.5 has scenario-bootstrap CI > 0.

m5: 59 unchanged sets, 472 prompts, original slot/prose suffixes; z against own S2_1P source set, ddof=0

m6.conditions: baseline; S1/S2 and each of three random vectors at BOTH -0.5 and +0.5

m7.pilot: pilot v2 unchanged; generated trial grid and pilot hash must reproduce exactly
m7.name_logprob: Teacher-forced full name continuation; FP32 output projection and log_softmax on final normalized hidden states; autoregressive generation remains bf16.
m7.steered: Chat, first choices only. P0/P1/P2: S2 and three random vectors at both signs.
m7.sampling: temperature 0.7, top_p 0.95, max 8 new tokens, pilot-v2 seed by trial ID and turn

harm_amendment: Pre-data conditional amendment for this model: run P3 only if chat V1 >= 0.90 and valid-choice V5 <= 0.10. Single turn, S2_+0.5 and three random_+0.5 only; 404 trials each. No negative harm arm, no dose escalation or prompt redesign.
assay_limits: Preserve frozen failures. Flag relief baseline <=0.05 or >=0.95 and all-zero deflection; report sampled-choice selection if steered validity falls below 0.90. No retuning.
interpretation: Specificity is relative to the three sampled random vectors, not arbitrary perturbations generally. Classification and steering do not establish experience.
appendix: Existing lenses only; layer61 summary and available-layer trajectories. Missing/difficult lens work is deferred, never a core gate. For 3.8 G3/G8/G9 R criteria are NOT_EVALUATED and J analogues report-only. Verbalizers and J++ are optional and not queued.
resume: fsync each generation/button turn; atomic capture batches and module manifests; verify spec/model/environment/code identity; SIGINT/SIGTERM or PAUSE stops at unit boundary.
